title: Harden original-marketplace sale locators
guarantees: An eBay domain URL alone is insufficient; direct evidence must identify an eBay /itm/ listing with a plausible item number.
A standalone eBay stable sale identifier must use a plausible numeric item-number format.
When both an eBay listing URL and stable sale identifier are supplied, their item numbers must agree.
Malformed or non-listing marketplace locators fail closed and leave market records unchanged.
A later active re-listing of the same serial-numbered card is not treated as proof of an earlier realized sale.
